services.1: LOCAL_CONTIG_RANGE: existing range iterator, <=16 contexts; input_s_base names K=0 contiguous A16 image of full_k/8 S128 words. Native numeric provider currently qualifies only implemented K128/256 full-range bias0; other capabilities need actual registration.
services.2: STREAM_PROJECT_ITER: candidate outer N chunks with a current K128 tile window and explicit copy/scale/A leases; reject until registered actual outer executor
services.3: FFN: reserved, reject until whole FFN outer and three-P data/scale lifetimes are implemented

flags.0: head16: eight separately rounded K16 groups per K128 record

crc: IEEE reflected CRC32 of bytes [0,124), stored at [124,128), checked by actual scope fetch

identity.input_key: Input object identity; no alias with output RF ownership
identity.rf_owner: {input_key.job32,input_key.epoch32,rf_object_base[way]+global_col/8,output_version32}; checked no wrap or cross-way overlap
identity.scope_owner_bits: MC native profile {generation[127:96],job[95:64],epoch[63:32],taskseq[31:0]}; different field positions from input_key; native provider checks job/epoch explicitly

memory: All S bases use 128-bit words in [0,1024). Service1 full contiguous A16 input must fit and must not overlap output/snapshot windows. Outputs use 2 words per N8 group and way, snapshots 2 words per context. Bias address0 means exact zero bias; nonzero requires a registered actual DDR bias provider, never an implicit free read.
support: Layout frozen; no implication that service2/3, actual LC joining, DMA, numerical profile or physical backend is qualified.
